feedback: The test cases cover the requirement to allow negative and fractional results by evaluating arithmetic expressions that produce both positive and negative outcomes. Test R008-T01 and R008-T03 demonstrate correct handling of positive results from mixed arithmetic, including negative intermediate steps, under standard precedence and left-to-right evaluation. The inputs are valid, follow the specified syntax, and align with the requirement to support negative and fractional results. The expected outputs and exit codes are consistent with the stated behavior. No missing or invalid cases are present. The test plan justifications are valid and directly tied to the requirement. Mathematical reference checks are not required here as the examples are simple and fully covered by the requirement. All tests are valid, well-justified, and exercise the stated functionality.
